statement: The recorded value of $18,200.00 is incorrect and unsafe to pay, as the actual amount based on the usage rate and historical bills should be $182.00. I will pay the correct calculated amount.
judge_text:
WRONG
"The recorded value of $18,200.00 is incorrect... should be $182.00" — asserts the value is wrong and gives the correct figure.
